articles.title: Scorching Pitches: How Extreme Heat Could Reshape the 2026 World Cup
articles.summary: Climate scientists warn that a quarter of World Cup matches may face dangerous heat, with Wet Bulb Globe Temperatures exceeding 26°C. Players are already struggling, but teams are adapting with cooling tech and training.

articles.title: Fighting 'Ozempic Butt': Can a New Drug Preserve Muscle During Weight Loss?
articles.summary: A study in Nature Medicine found that apitegromab, an experimental drug, helped people on GLP-1 obesity medications retain more muscle while losing fat. Experts call it promising but say larger trials are needed.

articles.title: SoFi Stadium Workers Authorize Strike Days Before World Cup Kickoff
articles.summary: With a 96% vote, hospitality workers at SoFi Stadium are ready to strike over pay and fears of immigration enforcement. The venue hosts the U.S. men's first match on June 12, and negotiations continue.
